verdict.rationale: Fastmail is a hosted email service, and self-hosting is a fair question for email products, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows that JMAP is an open standard any organisation can implement, plus an 'Open source and standards' page title with no content. Neither documents a way to run Fastmail itself on your own infrastructure, so the open protocol is at most an adjacent building block.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
